name: Canton of Zürich building act
law: Planungs- und Baugesetz des Kantons Zürich (PBG, LS 700.1), as in force on 1 January 2026
fail_means: It would not meet the Canton of Zürich's rule; other cantons set their own.

rules.title: A bedroom or living room is at least 10 m2 (canton of Zürich)

applies_to.note: Canton of Zürich only: Swiss building law is cantonal and there is no national limit. Rooms for living and sleeping (PBG s. 299). Not in single-family houses and comparable dwellings (s. 303). A dining area that is part of an open room (Essen, Repas, Pranzo) is not a room of its own and is not checked; kitchens are left out (the government may set other rules for them).

clause.ref: Planungs- und Baugesetz des Kantons Zürich (PBG, LS 700.1), § 303 Abs. 1
clause.quote: Die Mindestfläche von Räumen, ausser solchen in Einfamilienhäusern und bei vergleichbaren Wohnungsarten, beträgt 10 m².
clause.quote_en: The minimum area of rooms, except those in single-family houses and comparable kinds of dwelling, is 10 m2.

rules.title: A bedroom or living room has a window (canton of Zürich)

applies_to.note: Canton of Zürich only: Swiss building law is cantonal and there is no national limit. Rooms for living and sleeping (PBG s. 299). The act also asks for a window area of at least a tenth of the floor area; a plan shows no window heights, so only the presence of a window is checked. A room whose only opening is a door to a balcony or terrace is cannot tell (Swiss plans draw glazed balcony doors as doors). Exceptions for special conditions are allowed (s. 302 para. 3).

clause.ref: Planungs- und Baugesetz des Kantons Zürich (PBG, LS 700.1), § 302 Abs. 2
clause.quote: Wohn- und Schlafräume sind mit Fenstern zu versehen, die über dem Erdreich liegen, ins Freie führen und in ausreichendem Masse geöffnet werden können; die Fensterfläche hat wenigstens einen Zehntel der Bodenfläche zu betragen.
clause.quote_en: Living rooms and bedrooms must have windows that are above ground, open to the outside and can be opened sufficiently; the window area must be at least one tenth of the floor area.
